name: Ak Bars Bank
note: Official bank of FC Rubin; name on the upper front and logo patch on the sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt (official club store product photos, 2026-10-03). The largest shareholders per Cbonds' profile are Tatarstan state bodies and companies (over 50% combined). The stake list is single-sourced (Cbonds) and appears to date from the bank's June 2020 disclosure: the bank's own site and e-disclosure block scripted access, and its 2025 published IFRS statements redact shareholder detail as sensitive information. Claim ak-bars-bank-tatarstan-shareholders therefore rests on one source; the sponsor stays unrated pending a maintainer with access. Svyazinvestneftekhim, the republic's holding vehicle, states its sole shareholder is the Republic of Tatarstan.
